description: DPS ASTRA NOVA is a student-led space innovation team from Delhi Public School, Durgapur, India, dedicated to advancing scientific curiosity and technological creativity. Our mission is to develop an interactive Junior Astronaut Training Simulator that combines space science, realistic mission challenges, and intelligent learning.
summary: NOVARIS — Astra Nexus Academy is an immersive, interactive interplanetary university simulator designed to transform space science education into an engaging, hands-on experience. Players explore a futuristic space academy featuring classrooms, advanced research laboratories, astronaut training facilities, interactive missions, and dedicated scientific simulations. Powered by Agent Orion, an AI-based mentor, NOVARIS enables dynamic conversations, personalised guidance, and exploration across astronomy, physics, chemistry, biology, and space technology. Through realistic environments, interactive NPCs, mission-based learning, and practical virtual experiments, NOVARIS aims to make complex scientific concepts accessible, engaging, and memorable while inspiring the next generation of explorers, researchers, and innovators.
details:
Interactive NPCs — Academy instructors and personnel.

Research Laboratories — Biology, Chemistry and Physics.

Astronaut Training Centre — Space exploration training.

Astronomy Observatory — Exploration of astronomical concepts.

Interactive Classrooms — Subject-based learning.

Mission Centre — Challenges and mission progression.

Dedicated Simulation Facilities — Virtual scientific experiments.

Key Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AI integration and interactive web technologies.

Primary Objective: To make space science education immersive, interactive and accessible through a virtual interplanetary academy.
